title: The Bell of Souls
description: A colossal cracked humanoid figure composed of blue, orange, and white geometric shards holds an enormous bell above its head. Below, a stone courtyard is filled with rows of robed hooded figures facing a central skeletal figure emerging from swirling colorful vortexes and chains.
prompt: A towering cracked humanoid statue made of fragmented blue, orange and white geometric pieces holds a massive metal bell chained to its head. A swirling colorful vortex of chains and glowing orbs emanates from the bell, revealing a full skeleton floating beside it. On a stone courtyard below stand hundreds of identical blue hooded robed cultists facing the scene, with one central detailed hooded figure in the foreground, dark stormy sky, intricate linework, symbolic and surreal composition
